Priya (AE): quick sync — Nora from Zephyr asked us to lock POC success criteria today. They want a 4-week trial, must-haves:
- 95th pct latency < 250ms for single-turn queries
- Cost target ~ $400 / 1M requests (token-equivalent)
- Quality: end-to-end F1 drop <= 2% vs their current ensemble
Also they sent a security questionnaire (KMS + SSO + audit logs). Can we map these to acceptance gates?

Jules (SE): thanks — can you confirm expected qps and typical sequence lengths? that drives batching/quantization tradeoffs.

Nora (Customer): rough traffic will be bursty at 80 qps peak, sustained 25 qps. typical prompts ~ 120 tokens in, expecting ~ 60 tokens out. some docs with long context up to 1k tokens (rare).

Alex (Eng): noted. for 80 qps burst we'll propose dedicated pool with burst buffer + autoscale. baseline plan: canary on hosted variant (gpt-like open model) then scale to dedicated. fallback: smaller quantized variant if latency breaches.

Jules (SE): quick example traffic profile to use for our perf runs:
```
{
  "sustained_qps": 25,
  "peak_qps": 80,
  "p50_seq_len": 180,
  "p95_seq_len": 600
}
```
We should run 95th latency under that mix.

Priya (AE): on acceptance gating — propose 3 gates:
1) Perf gate: 95p latency <250ms on canary for 72h with no more than 5% error budget burn.
2) Cost gate: simulated monthly burn <= $400/1M request equivalent (we'll provide tokenized burn calc).
3) Quality gate: evals on their prompt-suite where F1 drop <= 2% and top-3 accuracy >= baseline.
If any gate fails, auto-fallback to baseline model and ops escalation.

Alex (Eng): pricing Q: for their projected volume estimate (1.3M req/mo equivalent), dedicated reserved node plan (2x A10s) with burst-enabled looks like $XXX/mo + overage. I'll put a calc in the doc. If they prefer pure hosted, we'd have higher per-token but no commit.

Nora (Customer): security questionnaire: main asks are KMS integration, retention windows, SSO audit logs, and SOC2 evidence. timeline for answers?

Priya (AE): we can deliver draft answers tomorrow (KMS + SSO + retention). Jules/Engs — can you attach SOC2 excerpts and KMS flow?

Jules (SE): will upload the KMS wiring diagram + sample IAM policy and the SOC2 summary by EOD. Also adding a short runbook snippet for canary rollback triggers.

deploy-bot: runbook template created: /runbooks/presales/zephyr-poc-canary.md (internal link) :white_check_mark:

Alex (Eng): small technical note re: quantization — 8-bit gives ~1.6x throughput but expect ~1-3% quality delta depending on decoder. we should include both quantized and fp16 datapoints in the eval matrix.

Priya (AE): next steps: (1) Jules uploads KMS + SOC2 by EOD, (2) Alex posts pricing calc and dedicated node config, (3) run perf with traffic profile within 48h and report 95p. I'll schedule a 30-min alignment with Nora for Thursday to review gates. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
